oh-my-dsh 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分级模型路由：think/build 模型分级、视觉委派（视觉模型只负责描述图片，工作模型负责执行操作）、图片生成，以及高影响操作守卫。

posts.en:
oh-my-dsh is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Tiered model routing for DeepSeek Harness: think/build model tiers, vision delegation (the vision model only describes images; the working model acts), image generation, and a high-impact guard.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4dac447ef3a5c1a5bd08.html
